title: Angkor Empire Marathon Review: Cambodia's Temple-Circuit Full Marathon
seo_title: Angkor Empire Marathon Review | Siem Reap Cambodia Race
meta_description: The Angkor Empire Marathon: August 2 at Angkor Wat, Siem Reap. A full marathon through Cambodia's UNESCO temple complex — one of Asia's most iconic race settings.
dek: Set for 2 August 2026 starting at Angkor Wat in Siem Reap, this full marathon routes through one of the world's greatest archaeological sites. A bucket-list Cambodian road race.
verdict: The Angkor Empire Marathon is Cambodia's premier full marathon — a road race routed through the Angkor Archaeological Park with Angkor Wat as its start-line backdrop. Unlike the Angkor Wat International Half Marathon (run by the National Olympic Committee), this event offers the full 42.195km distance, taking runners deeper into the temple complex. August is the wet season — humid, potentially rainy, but the pre-dawn start and the temple scenery make it worthwhile. For marathoners wanting the full Angkor experience, this is the distance option.

sections.heading: Full Marathon Through Angkor
paragraphs: The Angkor Empire Marathon offers what the Angkor Wat Half Marathon can't: the full 42.195km distance through the temple complex. [1] Starting at Angkor Wat at dawn, runners pass Bayon, Ta Prohm, and the Victory Gate. August humidity is the real challenge — pace accordingly.
